title: Separated lattice points of V: (2M+1)^dim V points of V, pairwise distance ≥ 2, norm ≤ 2M√(dim V)
statement: Let P, M ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace and r := dim V. Then there is a finite set S ⊆ ℝ^P with exactly (2M+1)^r elements such that every x ∈ S lies in V and satisfies ‖x‖ ≤ 2M√r, and dist(x, y) = ‖x − y‖ ≥ 2 for all distinct x, y ∈ S.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : ℕ), ∃ S : Finset (Euclid P), S.card = (2 * M + 1) ^ Module.finrank ℝ V ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ V) ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ‖x‖ ≤ 2 * M * Real.sqrt (Module.finrank ℝ V)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≠ y → 2 ≤ dist x y)
